info.name: RoadGuardSystem V2 API
info.description: Role-first Postman collection for operations advertised by the running OpenAPI v1 document. Start with 00 - Preflight. State-changing/destructive requests require explicit switches and a disposable account. Real email/OTP/invitation requests are manual and skipped by default. See docs/postman/README.md for role flows, local setup, current data blocker and routes not yet represented here.
